resale_co.name: Certificate of Continued Occupancy (CCO), residential
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Pompton Lakes Building Department (Construction Official), under Ordinance 91-30 (Borough Code Section 19-3)
resale_co.lead_time: The Building Department page says to allow three weeks to complete the process; the application form says to allow a minimum of 5 business days for processing
requirements: Pressure relief (blow-off) pipe on the water heater and boiler must extend down to 6 inches above the floor
Grip-sized handrails on steps with 3 or more risers; no open stairways
Guardrails at least 36 inches high, with no more than 4 inches between balusters, on porches and landings more than 30 inches above grade
Visible house numbers on the house (not on doors)
Secure, firm and sealed chimney connection from the water heater, furnace, boiler or stove
No loose or unprotected electric wires or uncovered boxes
Sidewalks maintained by the homeowner to Borough Code
Separate smoke alarm, carbon monoxide alarm and fire extinguisher check by the Fire Prevention Bureau before resale
Someone 18 or older must be present at the inspection

resale_co.how_to_apply: Complete the Residential CCO application (check Resale), sign it and submit it with a check payable to the Borough of Pompton Lakes to the Building Department, 25 Lenox Avenue. The office must have the completed application and fee before it schedules the inspection. Inspections are Tuesday through Friday, 3:30 to 5:30 pm. Contact the Fire Prevention Bureau separately for the smoke alarm and carbon monoxide alarm inspection.

evidence.quote: Continued Certificate of Occupancy (CCO) are required for the resale of residential homes and businesses as well as for change of tenancy. Forms may be obtained at the Building Department and appointments must be scheduled for the CCO Inspector to perform inspections. Please allow three weeks to complete the process.

This Inspection is required for the RESALE OR RENTAL of a dwelling unit in the Borough of Pompton Lakes. Prior to the scheduling of an inspection, this office must have a completed application with the appropriate fee.

C.C.O. inspections will be done on Tuesday through Friday between the hours of 3:30 to 5:30 pm. Someone 18 years of age OR older must be present at the location during the inspection. Please allow 5 business days for processing and inspections.

resale_co.notes: The Building Department page and the residential CCO form (linked as updated 8/15/2025) both say a Certificate of Continued Occupancy is required for resale and for a change of tenancy. The form prints Borough Code Section 19-3.7: $90.00 per residential application, one free follow-up inspection, then $25 per additional follow-up; the Construction Official may waive the fee if a certificate was issued for the premises within 90 days. The page says to allow three weeks for the whole process, while the form says a minimum of 5 business days for processing. Carmelina Fusaro's email building@pomptonlakes-nj.gov is the mail link on her Borough staff directory entry and is also the inspection request address on the Building Department page. The Construction/Zoning Official is Sal Poli (ext. 224, construction@pomptonlakes-nj.gov per the directory mail link). The Borough also keeps a Landlord Registration Form in its Form Center; rental registration is not a resale requirement.

requirements: The Borough's residential CCO form (2025) still lists a fire extinguisher with the smoke alarm and carbon monoxide alarm check by the Fire Prevention Bureau before resale or rental; the state removed the extinguisher from the state certificate in February 2025 (P.L.2025, c.19), so confirm with the Fire Prevention Bureau

fire_cert.notes: Borough Ordinance 23-23 (Chapter 18 Fire Prevention, Section 18-8C, adopted June 28, 2023) sets the smoke/CO certificate fee at the Uniform Fire Code schedule rather than a local amount. The amounts recorded are the state schedule in N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.9(d) as published by DCA in the NJ Register (50 N.J.R. 729(a), February 5, 2018); the DCA smoke certificate portal currently shows the same $45 / $90 / $161 tiers for state-enforced towns. No Borough fee sheet or form for the fire certificate is posted, so confirm the amount and the application method with the Fire Official. The Fire Department page says fire inspection fees for real estate transactions go to the municipality and the State, not to the volunteer department. The state directory lists the bureau fax as (866)902-4414. The Pompton Lakes Volunteer Fire Department (973-835-0072) handles emergency response. Re-checked 2026-10-06: Ordinance 23-23 is unchanged; a stray stamp mark (':2') sits inside its fee sentence in the PDF text, so the quote is split there. The state fee quotes now come from the text-searchable 2018 NJ Register notice instead of the scanned 2017 PDF; the amounts are the same.
